# English Bible high-priority language context audit

This is a context review, not an automatic replacement list. Scripture subject matter such as death, blood, slavery, sexual sin, judgment, and hell is not treated as profanity merely because it is sensitive. The focus is on language that sounds like profanity, insult, social-media slang, or anachronistic youth speech.

- Dataset: 66 books, 15,667 paragraph records
- Terms found: 21

He makes things right for them and their families, as long as they stick to His promises and do what He says.

Your hands are literally covered in blood, your fingers are dripping with guilt. You're constantly lying, and your tongue is always muttering messed-up stuff. Nobody stands up for what's right, and no one plays fair. You all trust in empty illusions, you tell lies, you cook up trouble and end up with more sin. It's like you're hatching snake eggs and weaving spider webs. Eat one of those eggs and you die; crack one open and a snake pops out. Those spider webs are useless for making clothes.
